column1: # blocco-c.tsv — the messages of block C: plan-check.sh, counterproof.sh, context-pack.sh, finalize.sh, gates.sh,
# blocks-independent.py and review-surface.sh, read by tools/lingua-converti.py (format: its docstring). The first row
# of a key is its source in v1.3.0, the following ones its twins. Rows of Python sites (.py files, !py, !f) and of
# the !awk mode feed the catalog and the check; their code was edited by hand. Three parts, one per lane of the
# block, each with its own header below.
# blocco-c.plan-check.tsv — the messages of plan-check.sh (block C, lane P), read by tools/lingua-converti.py.
# key <TAB> at <TAB> pre <TAB> post <TAB> names <TAB> en (format: the docstring of lingua-converti.py). Section
# plan-check. The stdout of basis and contract is NOT here (constraint 2: frozen in protocol-strings.list); the
# keywords VIOLAZIONE, AVVISO, ERRORE DURO, Percorso:, Scheletro:, S2: stay in the code (D2) and only the explanation
# after them is in the catalog. !py rows are the embedded Python PY2 (edited by hand: _msg.T), !awk rows strings of
# an awk program (edited by hand: the text reaches awk through ENVIRON).
